ana (docs): uploaded a focused PR with a tiny SDK + curl example for tier overrides, metering header, and dashboard mapping. PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/docs/pulls/1561
diego (eng): quick sync: canonical header = `X-Redwood-Metering`. Server accepts `X-Redwood-Meter` for back-compat; note that in docs.
maya (product): add one-line about billing when tier != account default (partners asked).
ana (docs): added JS and curl examples; billing note: 'Requests billed at the request tier; meter attribution follows X-Redwood-Metering.'
ana (docs): also added a 3-bullet migration checklist: 1) send X-Redwood-Metering with existing meter id, 2) map ingestion label `tier_label` -> `tier` if needed, 3) confirm burst credits show in Allowance panel after 24h.
qa-bot: Preview deployed https://deploy.previews.redwood/docs/1561 expires in 48h
diego (eng): LGTM, left small inline nit about timeout in JS snippet
ana (docs): will patch the timeout and merge after one more reviewer.
